g.text: LLM fields into Jev: AUC 0.865, against 0.711 when
the LLM decides alone. Real fields still win: 0.892.

g.text: About 5.3 small decisions per alert. Send them to a
decision model; keep the LLM for writing.

g.text: Check actions on trusted facts only. In Chapter 14,
that kept auto-close at 14% under injection, not 50%.
